details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23971-23989 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new hold check in `invoke_stall_judge` (`_sjp_hold_reason="$(_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason "${linked_pr_json}" "${stall_minutes}")"`, then `STALL_RECOVERY_SHOULD_INCREMENT="false"` and `return 1`) runs on any PR the picker returns, including the `cross_ref_last` fallback from `_stall_judge_pick_linked_pr` (lines 5275-5283), so an unrelated open draft PR, a PR with a `[skip ai]` title or a PR labelled `ai:merge-lease-wait` that only cites the issue skips the judge.
  WHY: Every tick logs `STALL_SKIP ... reason=pr_ai_hold ... source=judge_pick` and counts no attempt, so the ladder never advances and MAX_STALL_RECOVERIES_PER_ISSUE escalation is never reached; this is a new regression, and the suggested fix is to guard the check with `[ "${linked_pr_source}" = "implementation" ]` (all four reviewers rated it MAJOR).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5341-5353 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard` captures `_srg_body="$(_linked_prs_by_body_reference "${issue_num}" 2>/dev/null || true)"` at line 5350, and `_linked_prs_by_body_reference` (lines 5117-5131) turns a failed `gh pr list --search` into `[]` with `|| echo "[]"`, so a failed body search cannot be told apart from an empty result.
  WHY: An implementation PR found only through a body close keyword drops out of the candidate set, and `[ -n "${_srg_candidates}" ] || return 0` allows close_and_reissue; this breaks the guard's "fail CLOSED on any read error" contract, while the cross-ref and branch lookups do refuse with `check_unavailable` (all rated MAJOR; confidence ranged 3-4).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25052-25068 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The merge-lease hold lapse compares the caller's `stall_minutes`/`elapsed_minutes` with `STALL_MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_MAX_MINUTES` instead of the age of the label's `labeled` event; the docstring claim at lines 25012-25013 that the stall clock is "never shorter than the label's age" is false (openai_gpt-6-luna also cites 23978-84).
  WHY: A label newly applied to an issue that is already past the threshold lapses at the first evaluation, which removes lease protection (for example for `retrigger_review` at 22128-22132); a phase-change reset of the stall clock can keep a stale label held indefinitely (all rated MAJOR).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5245-5285 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_stall_judge_pick_linked_pr` caps the candidate fetch loop at 20 (`[ "${_sjp_fetches}" -lt 20 ] || break`, cited at line 5258 or 5264) and then falls back to `cross_ref_last`, so candidates 21 and later are never inspected.
  WHY: An implementation PR beyond position 20 in the `_find_all_linked_prs` union is missed, together with its lease-wait hold, and the judge sees the wrong PR, as in the pre-#9892 incident; severity is disputed (gemini and minimax MAJOR, glm NIT because the final guard still blocks closing a green head), so the highest is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5232-5283 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The picker makes one `pulls/<n>` fetch per candidate (up to 20), reads the timeline a second time through `_issue_cross_ref_pr_number_last` on fallback, and `invoke_stall_judge` fetches the chosen PR again (lines 23960-23965).
  WHY: Each judge invocation can spend about 20-22 extra REST calls from the shared rate-limit budget, which exceeds the issue's limit of "at most the two `gh pr list` calls" (all rated NIT).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:35957 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked judge `close_and_reissue` arm calls `_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard "${rb_issue}"` without `stall_minutes`, so `_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason` never returns `merge_lease_wait` (the `[ -n "${_spahr_stall_minutes}" ]` guard at line 25053).
  WHY: An open implementation PR labelled `ai:merge-lease-wait` with a non-green head is not refused on this arm, which deviates from the step 2 hold requirement; the other reviewers raised this as a task gap (rated MAJOR).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25060 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The lapse marker file uses the predictable path `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/stall_merge_lease_lapse.$$` and is written with `>>`, without exclusive creation.
  WHY: The path is open to pre-creation or symlink attacks, with minimal impact on ephemeral runners; sonnet, minimax and glm raised the same point as hardening suggestions only (rated NIT).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:28857-28860 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A close_and_reissue refusal on the standalone ladder only echoes, while the managed arm (21876-21880) and the review-blocked arm (35959) both call `tg_notify ... "DEBUG"`.
  WHY: Operators watching Telegram never see standalone refusals, for example a `check_unavailable` refusal repeated every tick; sonnet and minimax raised the same point as hardening suggestions only (rated NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Bounded wait: when the PR has carried the label for more than STALL_MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_MAX_MINUTES (default 1440), the hold lapses, logs once and falls through to today's path ... The wait is measured from the label's last `labeled` event, which the issue timeline the stall path already fetches carries."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, `_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason` lapse branch (lines 25053-25068), plus its stall-recovery callers (lines 22129, 22790, 23979, 28546, 29104, 30175, 30178) and the stall-path timeline handling
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The lapse at lines 25053-25059 compares `stall_minutes`/`elapsed_minutes` with the maximum, and nothing reads the `labeled` event timestamp; the docstring at lines 25017-25019 falsely claims the stall clock is never shorter than the label's age; `status_since_ts` is reset on every recovery action (lines 28785, 29440, 29455, 29604); README.md ("Measured on the issue's stall clock") and the agents.d fragment document the deviation; a new label on an old stalled issue lapses at once and falls through to `retrigger_review`, which pushes an empty commit onto the PR waiting for the lease (gemini rated this BLOCKER; the others rated it MAJOR).
- requirement: For each `close_and_reissue` branch (":22240, :28990, :35605"), the guard "checks ... or whether the PR is held per step 2", and the step 2 hold includes `merge_lease_wait`.
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:35957 (review-blocked judge `close_and_reissue` arm, `_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard "${rb_issue}"`)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The guard is called with no stall clock, and `_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason` prints `merge_lease_wait` only when `_spahr_stall_minutes` is non-empty (line 25053); the comment at lines 35952-35954 acknowledges "the merge-lease hold is stall-only"; a lease-labelled PR with a non-green head can be closed, while a green head is still refused through `green_head` (sonnet and glm rated this NIT; gemini, minimax and luna rated it MAJOR).
- requirement: "Done when: the new tests pass; the orchestrator suite passes", and the PR's acceptance table lists `tests/test_stall_recovery_pr_lookup.py` and `lint`.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_stall_recovery_pr_lookup.py and the shellcheck/lint gate over scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The pre-push gate table marks `tests/test_stall_recovery_pr_lookup.py` and `lint` as "not run" and reports "Failures caused by this change: 1 — shellcheck"; CI check-runs show 0 failures, so the shellcheck failure is unexplained and unverified.
- requirement: "The candidate lookup adds at most the two `gh pr list` calls `_find_all_linked_prs` already makes."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, `_stall_judge_pick_linked_pr`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The picker fetches each candidate individually, up to 20 times, and does another timeline lookup on fallback.
- requirement: "Pick the first open PR from `_find_all_linked_prs` that passes `_linked_pr_is_issue_implementation`."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, `_stall_judge_pick_linked_pr`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The loop stops after 20 candidates at lines 5258-59, so an implementation PR later in the sorted list is never checked.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:invoke_stall_judge, lines 23974-23985; picker fallback lines 5275-5283 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The hold check runs on the `cross_ref_last` fallback PR, so an unrelated draft PR, `[skip ai]` PR or PR labelled `ai:merge-lease-wait` skips the judge with a `pr_ai_hold` reason.
  WHY: Callers at lines 30202 and 28875 freeze any stalled phase that has no implementation PR (`STALL_SKIP ... source=judge_pick`, no attempt counted, the ladder never escalates); fix: guard with `[ "${linked_pr_source}" = "implementation" ]`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard, line 5350; _linked_prs_by_body_reference, lines 5122-5124 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failed body-reference `gh pr list` becomes `[]`, so the guard does not fail closed.
  WHY: An implementation PR found only through the body lookup is skipped, the guard returns 0, and `close_linked_pr` may close the green PR unmerged or the issue is reissued while the PR stays open; fix: run the search inline in the guard with a failure check that refuses with `check_unavailable`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_stall_judge_pick_linked_pr, lines 5255-5283; invoke_stall_judge, line 23965 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The picker adds up to 20 `pulls/<n>` calls, a second timeline read and a duplicate fetch of the fallback PR.
  WHY: This spends about 22 extra API calls per stalled issue per tick from the shared budget, which exceeds the issue's constraint.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: "Bounded wait ... The wait is measured from the label's last `labeled` event ..."
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, lapse branch of _stall_pr_ai_hold_reason (lines 25053-25068), and the callers at lines 22129, 22790, 23979, 28546, 29104, 30175, 30178.
  Evidence of absence: The lapse uses the issue stall clock, and no `labeled` event is read; the header comment's claim is false; an issue more than 1440 minutes into ai:done lapses as soon as the label appears and falls through to retrigger_review; README.md documents the deviation.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Requirement: For each close_and_reissue branch, the guard "checks ... or whether the PR is held per step 2" (which includes merge_lease_wait).
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, line 35957.
  Evidence of absence: The arm passes no stal
